surah.personality_title: Surah Sad (The Letter of Sovereign Remembrance)
surah.personality_summary: Surah Sad (the 38th chapter of the Qur'an, 88 verses) was revealed in Makkah during an intense period of aristocratic confrontation. Historically occasioned by the high-level delegation of 25 Qurayshi tribal chieftains (including Abu Jahl, 'Utbah ibn Rabi'ah, and Umayyah ibn Khalaf) convening at the deathbed of Abu Talib, the surah confronts the core psychological root of disbelief: pride, entrenched entitlement, and tribal exceptionalism (Fee 'Izzatin wa Shiqāq).
surah.opening_ending_dynamic: Connects opening theme to terminal resolution.
surah.overview: Surah Saad (The letter Saad) is the 38th surah in the canonical muṣḥaf sequence, comprising 88 ayat. Classified as Makki.

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: صٓۚ وَٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ ذِي ٱلذِّكۡرِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ ص ۚ وَالْقُرْآنِ ذِي الذِّكْرِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ص ۚ والقران ذي الذكر
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Sad. By the Qur'an containing reminder
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Sad By the Quran with its reminding

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ فِي عِزَّةࣲ وَشِقَاقࣲ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: بَلِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا فِي عِزَّةٍ وَشِقَاقٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: بل الذين كفروا في عزة وشقاق
ayahs.translation_saheeh: But those who disbelieve are in pride and dissension
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Yet the disbelievers are steeped in arrogance and hostility

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: كَمۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَا مِن قَبۡلِهِم مِّن قَرۡنࣲ فَنَادَواْ وَّلَاتَ حِينَ مَنَاصࣲ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ مِنْ قَرْنٍ فَنَادَوْا وَلَاتَ حِينَ مَنَاصٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: كم اهلكنا من قبلهم من قرن فنادوا ولات حين مناص
ayahs.translation_saheeh: How many a generation have We destroyed before them, and they [then] called out; but it was not a time for escape
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: How many generations We have destroyed before them! They all cried out, once it was too late, for escape

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَعَجِبُوٓاْ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرࣱ مِّنۡهُمۡۖ وَقَالَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا سَٰحِرࣱ كَذَّابٌ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَعَجِبُوا أَنْ جَاءَهُمْ مُنْذِرٌ مِنْهُمْ ۖ وَقَالَ الْكَافِرُونَ هَٰذَا سَاحِرٌ كَذَّابٌ
ayahs.arabic_clean: وعجبوا ان جاءهم منذر منهم ۖ وقال الكافرون هذا ساحر كذاب
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And they wonder that there has come to them a warner from among themselves. And the disbelievers say, "This is a magician and a liar
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: The disbelievers think it strange that a prophet of their own people has come to warn them: they say, ‘He is just a lying sorcerer

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: أَجَعَلَ ٱلۡأٓلِهَةَ إِلَٰهࣰ ا وَٰحِدًاۖ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَشَيۡءٌ عُجَابࣱ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: أَجَعَلَ الْآلِهَةَ إِلَٰهًا وَاحِدًا ۖ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَشَيْءٌ عُجَابٌ
ayahs.arabic_clean: اجعل الالهة الها واحدا ۖ ان هذا لشيء عجاب
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Has he made the gods [only] one God? Indeed, this is a curious thing
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: How can he claim that all the gods are but one God? What an astonishing thing [to claim]!’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَٱنطَلَقَ ٱلۡمَلَأُ مِنۡهُمۡ أَنِ ٱمۡشُواْ وَٱصۡبِرُواْ عَلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِكُمۡۖ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَشَيۡءࣱ يُرَادُ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَانْطَلَقَ الْمَلَأُ مِنْهُمْ أَنِ امْشُوا وَاصْبِرُوا عَلَىٰ آلِهَتِكُمْ ۖ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَشَيْءٌ يُرَادُ
ayahs.arabic_clean: وانطلق الملا منهم ان امشوا واصبروا على الهتكم ۖ ان هذا لشيء يراد
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And the eminent among them went forth, [saying], "Continue, and be patient over [the defense of] your gods. Indeed, this is a thing intended
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Their leaders depart, saying, ‘Walk away! Stay faithful to your gods! That is what you must do

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: مَا سَمِعۡنَا بِهَٰذَا فِي ٱلۡمِلَّةِ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ إِنۡ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا ٱخۡتِلَٰقٌ
ayahs.arabic_simple: مَا سَمِعْنَا بِهَٰذَا فِي الْمِلَّةِ الْآخِرَةِ إِنْ هَٰذَا إِلَّا اخْتِلَاقٌ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ما سمعنا بهذا في الملة الاخرة ان هذا الا اختلاق
ayahs.translation_saheeh: We have not heard of this in the latest religion. This is not but a fabrication
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We did not hear any such claim in the last religion: it is all an invention

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: أَءُنزِلَ عَلَيۡهِ ٱلذِّكۡرُ مِنۢ بَيۡنِنَاۚ بَلۡ هُمۡ فِي شَكࣲّ مِّن ذِكۡرِيۚ بَل لَّمَّا يَذُوقُواْ عَذَابِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: أَأُنْزِلَ عَلَيْهِ الذِّكْرُ مِنْ بَيْنِنَا ۚ بَلْ هُمْ فِي شَكٍّ مِنْ ذِكْرِي ۖ بَلْ لَمَّا يَذُوقُوا عَذَابِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: اانزل عليه الذكر من بيننا ۚ بل هم في شك من ذكري ۖ بل لما يذوقوا عذاب
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Has the message been revealed to him out of [all of] us?" Rather, they are in doubt about My message. Rather, they have not yet tasted My punishment
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Was the message sent only to him out of all of us?’ In fact they doubt My warning; in fact they have not tasted My punishment yet

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: أَمۡ عِندَهُمۡ خَزَآئِنُ رَحۡمَةِ رَبِّكَ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡوَهَّابِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: أَمْ عِنْدَهُمْ خَزَائِنُ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّكَ الْعَزِيزِ الْوَهَّابِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ام عندهم خزائن رحمة ربك العزيز الوهاب
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Or do they have the depositories of the mercy of your Lord, the Exalted in Might, the Bestower
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Do they possess the treasures of your Lord’s bounty, the Mighty, the All Giving

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: أَمۡ لَهُم مُّلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَاۖ فَلۡيَرۡتَقُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَسۡبَٰبِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: أَمْ لَهُمْ مُلْكُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ۖ فَلْيَرْتَقُوا فِي الْأَسْبَابِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ام لهم ملك السماوات والارض وما بينهما ۖ فليرتقوا في الاسباب
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Or is theirs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and what is between them? Then let them ascend through [any] ways of access
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Do they control the heavens and earth and everything between? Let them climb their ropes

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: جُندࣱ مَّا هُنَالِكَ مَهۡزُومࣱ مِّنَ ٱلۡأَحۡزَابِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: جُنْدٌ مَا هُنَالِكَ مَهْزُومٌ مِنَ الْأَحْزَابِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: جند ما هنالك مهزوم من الاحزاب
ayahs.translation_saheeh: [They are but] soldiers [who will be] defeated there among the companies [of disbelievers]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: their armed alliance is weak and will be crushed

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: كَذَّبَتۡ قَبۡلَهُمۡ قَوۡمُ نُوحࣲ وَعَادࣱ وَفِرۡعَوۡنُ ذُو ٱلۡأَوۡتَادِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَعَادٌ وَفِرْعَوْنُ ذُو الْأَوْتَادِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: كذبت قبلهم قوم نوح وعاد وفرعون ذو الاوتاد
ayahs.translation_saheeh: The people of Noah denied before them, and [the tribe of] 'Aad and Pharaoh, the owner of stakes
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: The people of Noah, Ad, and firmly-supported Pharaoh rejected their prophets before them

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَثَمُودُ وَقَوۡمُ لُوطࣲ وَأَصۡحَٰبُ لۡـَٔيۡكَةِۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ ٱلۡأَحۡزَابُ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَثَمُودُ وَقَوْمُ لُوطٍ وَأَصْحَابُ الْأَيْكَةِ ۚ أُولَٰئِكَ الْأَحْزَابُ
ayahs.arabic_clean: وثمود وقوم لوط واصحاب الايكة ۚ اولئك الاحزاب
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And [the tribe of] Thamud and the people of Lot and the companions of the thicket. Those are the companies
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Thamud, the people of Lot, and the Forest-Dwellers each formed opposition [against theirs]

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِن كُلٌّ إِلَّا كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ عِقَابِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِنْ كُلٌّ إِلَّا كَذَّبَ الرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ عِقَابِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ان كل الا كذب الرسل فحق عقاب
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Each of them denied the messengers, so My penalty was justified
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: They all rejected the mes-sengers and they were deservedly struck by My punishment

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَمَا يَنظُرُ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ إِلَّا صَيۡحَةࣰ وَٰحِدَةࣰ مَّا لَهَا مِن فَوَاقࣲ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَمَا يَنْظُرُ هَٰؤُلَاءِ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَاحِدَةً مَا لَهَا مِنْ فَوَاقٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: وما ينظر هؤلاء الا صيحة واحدة ما لها من فواق
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And these [disbelievers] await not but one blast [of the Horn]; for it there will be no delay
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: all the disbelievers here are waiting for is a single blast that cannot be postponed

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَقَالُواْ رَبَّنَا عَجِّل لَّنَا قِطَّنَا قَبۡلَ يَوۡمِ ٱلۡحِسَابِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَقَالُوا رَبَّنَا عَجِّلْ لَنَا قِطَّنَا قَبْلَ يَوْمِ الْحِسَابِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: وقالوا ربنا عجل لنا قطنا قبل يوم الحساب
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And they say, "Our Lord, hasten for us our share [of the punishment] before the Day of Account
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: They say, ‘Our Lord! Advance us our share of punishment before the Day of Reckoning!’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: ٱصۡبِرۡ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱذۡكُرۡ عَبۡدَنَا دَاوُۥدَ ذَا ٱلۡأَيۡدِۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
ayahs.arabic_simple: اصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَاذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَا دَاوُودَ ذَا الْأَيْدِ ۖ إِنَّهُ أَوَّابٌ
ayahs.arabic_clean: اصبر على ما يقولون واذكر عبدنا داوود ذا الايد ۖ انه اواب
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Be patient over what they say and remember Our servant, David, the possessor of strength; indeed, he was one who repeatedly turned back [to Allah]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Bear their words patiently [Prophet]. Remember Our servant David, a man of strength who always turned to Us

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِنَّا سَخَّرۡنَا ٱلۡجِبَالَ مَعَهُۥ يُسَبِّحۡنَ بِٱلۡعَشِيِّ وَٱلۡإِشۡرَاقِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِنَّا سَخَّرْنَا الْجِبَالَ مَعَهُ يُسَبِّحْنَ بِالْعَشِيِّ وَالْإِشْرَاقِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: انا سخرنا الجبال معه يسبحن بالعشي والاشراق
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, We subjected the mountains [to praise] with him, exalting [Allah] in the [late] afternoon and [after] sunrise
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We made the mountains join him in glorifying Us at sunset and sunrise

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَٱلطَّيۡرَ مَحۡشُورَةࣰۖ كُلࣱّ لَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابࣱ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَالطَّيْرَ مَحْشُورَةً ۖ كُلٌّ لَهُ أَوَّابٌ
ayahs.arabic_clean: والطير محشورة ۖ كل له اواب
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And the birds were assembled, all with him repeating [praises]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and the birds, too, in flocks, all echoed his praise

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَشَدَدۡنَا مُلۡكَهُۥ وَءَاتَيۡنَٰهُ ٱلۡحِكۡمَةَ وَفَصۡلَ ٱلۡخِطَابِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَشَدَدْنَا مُلْكَهُ وَآتَيْنَاهُ الْحِكْمَةَ وَفَصْلَ الْخِطَابِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: وشددنا ملكه واتيناه الحكمة وفصل الخطاب
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And We strengthened his kingdom and gave him wisdom and discernment in speech
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We strengthened his kingdom; We gave him wisdom and a decisive way of speaking

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: ۞وَهَلۡ أَتَىٰكَ نَبَؤُاْ ٱلۡخَصۡمِ إِذۡ تَسَوَّرُواْ ٱلۡمِحۡرَابَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: ۞ وَهَلْ أَتَاكَ نَبَأُ الْخَصْمِ إِذْ تَسَوَّرُوا الْمِحْرَابَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ۞ وهل اتاك نبا الخصم اذ تسوروا المحراب
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And has there come to you the news of the adversaries, when they climbed over the wall of [his] prayer chamber
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Have you heard the story of the two litigants who climbed into his private quarters

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِذۡ دَخَلُواْ عَلَىٰ دَاوُۥدَ فَفَزِعَ مِنۡهُمۡۖ قَالُواْ لَا تَخَفۡۖ خَصۡمَانِ بَغَىٰ بَعۡضُنَا عَلَىٰ بَعۡضࣲ فَٱحۡكُم بَيۡنَنَا بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَلَا تُشۡطِطۡ وَٱهۡدِنَآ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلصِّرَٰطِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِذْ دَخَلُوا عَلَىٰ دَاوُودَ فَفَزِعَ مِنْهُمْ ۖ قَالُوا لَا تَخَفْ ۖ خَصْمَانِ بَغَىٰ بَعْضُنَا عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ فَاحْكُمْ بَيْنَنَا بِالْحَقِّ وَلَا تُشْطِطْ وَاهْدِنَا إِلَىٰ سَوَاءِ الصِّرَاطِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: اذ دخلوا على داوود ففزع منهم ۖ قالوا لا تخف ۖ خصمان بغى بعضنا على بعض فاحكم بيننا بالحق ولا تشطط واهدنا الى سواء الصراط
ayahs.translation_saheeh: When they entered upon David and he was alarmed by them? They said, "Fear not. [We are] two adversaries, one of whom has wronged the other, so judge between us with truth and do not exceed [it] and guide us to the sound path
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: When they reached David, he took fright, but they said, ‘Do not be afraid. We are two litigants, one of whom has wronged the other: judge between us fairly- do not be unjust- and guide us to the right path

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِنَّ هَٰذَآ أَخِي لَهُۥ تِسۡعࣱ وَتِسۡعُونَ نَعۡجَةࣰ وَلِيَ نَعۡجَةࣱ وَٰحِدَةࣱ فَقَالَ أَكۡفِلۡنِيهَا وَعَزَّنِي فِي ٱلۡخِطَابِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِنَّ هَٰذَا أَخِي لَهُ تِسْعٌ وَتِسْعُونَ نَعْجَةً وَلِيَ نَعْجَةٌ وَاحِدَةٌ فَقَالَ أَكْفِلْنِيهَا وَعَزَّنِي فِي الْخِطَابِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ان هذا اخي له تسع وتسعون نعجة ولي نعجة واحدة فقال اكفلنيها وعزني في الخطاب
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed this, my brother, has ninety-nine ewes, and I have one ewe; so he said, 'Entrust her to me,' and he overpowered me in speech
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: This is my brother. He had ninety-nine ewes and I just the one, and he said, “Let me take charge of her,” and overpowered me with his words.’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: قَالَ لَقَدۡ ظَلَمَكَ بِسُؤَالِ نَعۡجَتِكَ إِلَىٰ نِعَاجِهِۦۖ وَإِنَّ كَثِيرࣰ ا مِّنَ ٱلۡخُلَطَآءِ لَيَبۡغِي بَعۡضُهُمۡ عَلَىٰ بَعۡضٍ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَقَلِيلࣱ مَّا هُمۡۗ وَظَنَّ دَاوُۥدُ أَنَّمَا فَتَنَّٰهُ فَٱسۡتَغۡفَرَ رَبَّهُۥ وَخَرَّۤ رَاكِعࣰ اۤ وَأَنَابَ۩
ayahs.arabic_simple: قَالَ لَقَدْ ظَلَمَكَ بِسُؤَالِ نَعْجَتِكَ إِلَىٰ نِعَاجِهِ ۖ وَإِنَّ كَثِيرًا مِنَ الْخُلَطَاءِ لَيَبْغِي بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ إِلَّا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ وَقَلِيلٌ مَا هُمْ ۗ وَظَنَّ دَاوُودُ أَنَّمَا فَتَنَّاهُ فَاسْتَغْفَرَ رَبَّهُ وَخَرَّ رَاكِعًا وَأَنَابَ ۩
ayahs.arabic_clean: قال لقد ظلمك بسؤال نعجتك الى نعاجه ۖ وان كثيرا من الخلطاء ليبغي بعضهم على بعض الا الذين امنوا وعملوا الصالحات وقليل ما هم ۗ وظن داوود انما فتناه فاستغفر ربه وخر راكعا واناب ۩
ayahs.translation_saheeh: [David] said, "He has certainly wronged you in demanding your ewe [in addition] to his ewes. And indeed, many associates oppress one another, except for those who believe and do righteous deeds - and few are they." And David became certain that We had tried him, and he asked forgiveness of his Lord and fell down bowing [in prostration] and turned in repentance [to Allah]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: David said, ‘He has done you wrong by demanding to add your ewe to his flock. Many partners treat each other unfairly. Those who sincerely believe and do good deeds do not do this, but these are very few.’ [Then] David realized that We had been testing him, so he asked his Lord for forgiveness, fell down on his knees, and repented

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَغَفَرۡنَا لَهُۥ ذَٰلِكَۖ وَإِنَّ لَهُۥ عِندَنَا لَزُلۡفَىٰ وَحُسۡنَ مَـَٔابࣲ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَغَفَرْنَا لَهُ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَإِنَّ لَهُ عِنْدَنَا لَزُلْفَىٰ وَحُسْنَ مَآبٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: فغفرنا له ذلك ۖ وان له عندنا لزلفى وحسن ماب
ayahs.translation_saheeh: So We forgave him that; and indeed, for him is nearness to Us and a good place of return
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We forgave him [his misdeed]. His reward will be nearness to Us, a good place to return to

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: يَٰدَاوُۥدُ إِنَّا جَعَلۡنَٰكَ خَلِيفَةࣰ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَٱحۡكُم بَيۡنَ ٱلنَّاسِ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَلَا تَتَّبِعِ ٱلۡهَوَىٰ فَيُضِلَّكَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَضِلُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ لَهُمۡ عَذَابࣱ شَدِيدُۢ بِمَا نَسُواْ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡحِسَابِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: يَا دَاوُودُ إِنَّا جَعَلْنَاكَ خَلِيفَةً فِي الْأَرْضِ فَاحْكُمْ بَيْنَ النَّاسِ بِالْحَقِّ وَلَا تَتَّبِعِ الْهَوَىٰ فَيُضِلَّكَ عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ الَّذِينَ يَضِلُّونَ عَنْ سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ بِمَا نَسُوا يَوْمَ الْحِسَابِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: يا داوود انا جعلناك خليفة في الارض فاحكم بين الناس بالحق ولا تتبع الهوى فيضلك عن سبيل الله ۚ ان الذين يضلون عن سبيل الله لهم عذاب شديد بما نسوا يوم الحساب
ayahs.translation_saheeh: [We said], "O David, indeed We have made you a successor upon the earth, so judge between the people in truth and do not follow [your own] desire, as it will lead you astray from the way of Allah." Indeed, those who go astray from the way of Allah will have a severe punishment for having forgotten the Day of Account
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: ‘David, We have given you mastery over the land. Judge fairly between people. Do not follow your desires, lest they divert you from God’s path: those who wander from His path will have a painful torment because they ignore the Day of Reckoning.’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَمَا خَلَقۡنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا بَٰطِلࣰ اۚ ذَٰلِكَ ظَنُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْۚ فَوَيۡلࣱ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِنَ ٱلنَّارِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا السَّمَاءَ وَالْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا بَاطِلًا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ظَنُّ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا ۚ فَوَيْلٌ لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مِنَ النَّارِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: وما خلقنا السماء والارض وما بينهما باطلا ۚ ذلك ظن الذين كفروا ۚ فويل للذين كفروا من النار
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And We did not create the heaven and the earth and that between them aimlessly. That is the assumption of those who disbelieve, so woe to those who disbelieve from the Fire
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: It was not without purpose that We created the heavens and the earth and everything in between. That may be what the disbelievers assume- how they will suffer from the Fire

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: أَمۡ نَجۡعَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ كَٱلۡمُفۡسِدِينَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ أَمۡ نَجۡعَلُ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ كَٱلۡفُجَّارِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: أَمْ نَجْعَلُ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ كَالْمُفْسِدِينَ فِي الْأَرْضِ أَمْ نَجْعَلُ الْمُتَّقِينَ كَالْفُجَّارِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ام نجعل الذين امنوا وعملوا الصالحات كالمفسدين في الارض ام نجعل المتقين كالفجار
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Or should we treat those who believe and do righteous deeds like corrupters in the land? Or should We treat those who fear Allah like the wicked
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: but would We treat those who believe and do good deeds and those who spread corruption on earth as equal? Would We treat those who are aware of God and those who recklessly break all bounds in the same way

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: كِتَٰبٌ أَنزَلۡنَٰهُ إِلَيۡكَ مُبَٰرَكࣱ لِّيَدَّبَّرُوٓاْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ وَلِيَتَذَكَّرَ أُوْلُواْ ٱلۡأَلۡبَٰبِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: كِتَابٌ أَنْزَلْنَاهُ إِلَيْكَ مُبَارَكٌ لِيَدَّبَّرُوا آيَاتِهِ وَلِيَتَذَكَّرَ أُولُو الْأَلْبَابِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: كتاب انزلناه اليك مبارك ليدبروا اياته وليتذكر اولو الالباب
ayahs.translation_saheeh: [This is] a blessed Book which We have revealed to you, [O Muhammad], that they might reflect upon its verses and that those of understanding would be reminded
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: This is a blessed Scripture which We sent down to you [Muhammad], for people to think about its messages, and for those with understanding to take heed

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَوَهَبۡنَا لِدَاوُۥدَ سُلَيۡمَٰنَۚ نِعۡمَ ٱلۡعَبۡدُ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَوَهَبْنَا لِدَاوُودَ سُلَيْمَانَ ۚ نِعْمَ الْعَبْدُ ۖ إِنَّهُ أَوَّابٌ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ووهبنا لداوود سليمان ۚ نعم العبد ۖ انه اواب
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And to David We gave Solomon. An excellent servant, indeed he was one repeatedly turning back [to Allah]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We gave David Solomon. He was an excellent servant who always turned to God

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِذۡ عُرِضَ عَلَيۡهِ بِٱلۡعَشِيِّ ٱلصَّٰفِنَٰتُ ٱلۡجِيَادُ
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِذْ عُرِضَ عَلَيْهِ بِالْعَشِيِّ الصَّافِنَاتُ الْجِيَادُ
ayahs.arabic_clean: اذ عرض عليه بالعشي الصافنات الجياد
ayahs.translation_saheeh: [Mention] when there were exhibited before him in the afternoon the poised [standing] racehorses
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: When well-bred light-footed horses were paraded before him near the close of day

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَقَالَ إِنِّيٓ أَحۡبَبۡتُ حُبَّ ٱلۡخَيۡرِ عَن ذِكۡرِ رَبِّي حَتَّىٰ تَوَارَتۡ بِٱلۡحِجَابِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَقَالَ إِنِّي أَحْبَبْتُ حُبَّ الْخَيْرِ عَنْ ذِكْرِ رَبِّي حَتَّىٰ تَوَارَتْ بِالْحِجَابِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: فقال اني احببت حب الخير عن ذكر ربي حتى توارت بالحجاب
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And he said, "Indeed, I gave preference to the love of good [things] over the remembrance of my Lord until the sun disappeared into the curtain [of darkness]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: he kept saying, ‘My love of fine things is part of my remembering my Lord!’ until [the horses] disappeared from sight

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: رُدُّوهَا عَلَيَّۖ فَطَفِقَ مَسۡحَۢا بِٱلسُّوقِ وَٱلۡأَعۡنَاقِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: رُدُّوهَا عَلَيَّ ۖ فَطَفِقَ مَسْحًا بِالسُّوقِ وَالْأَعْنَاقِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ردوها علي ۖ فطفق مسحا بالسوق والاعناق
ayahs.translation_saheeh: [He said], "Return them to me," and set about striking [their] legs and necks
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: ‘Bring them back!’ [he said] and started to stroke their legs and necks

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ فَتَنَّا سُلَيۡمَٰنَ وَأَلۡقَيۡنَا عَلَىٰ كُرۡسِيِّهِۦ جَسَدࣰ ا ثُمَّ أَنَابَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا سُلَيْمَانَ وَأَلْقَيْنَا عَلَىٰ كُرْسِيِّهِ جَسَدًا ثُمَّ أَنَابَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ولقد فتنا سليمان والقينا على كرسيه جسدا ثم اناب
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And We certainly tried Solomon and placed on his throne a body; then he returned
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We certainly tested Solomon, reducing him to a mere skeleton on his throne

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱغۡفِرۡ لِي وَهَبۡ لِي مُلۡكࣰ ا لَّا يَنۢبَغِي لِأَحَدࣲ مِّنۢ بَعۡدِيٓۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلۡوَهَّابُ
ayahs.arabic_simple: قَالَ رَبِّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَهَبْ لِي مُلْكًا لَا يَنْبَغِي لِأَحَدٍ مِنْ بَعْدِي ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْوَهَّابُ
ayahs.arabic_clean: قال رب اغفر لي وهب لي ملكا لا ينبغي لاحد من بعدي ۖ انك انت الوهاب
ayahs.translation_saheeh: He said, "My Lord, forgive me and grant me a kingdom such as will not belong to anyone after me. Indeed, You are the Bestower
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: He turned to Us and prayed: ‘Lord forgive me! Grant me such power as no one after me will have- You are the Most Generous Provider.’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَسَخَّرۡنَا لَهُ ٱلرِّيحَ تَجۡرِي بِأَمۡرِهِۦ رُخَآءً حَيۡثُ أَصَابَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَسَخَّرْنَا لَهُ الرِّيحَ تَجْرِي بِأَمْرِهِ رُخَاءً حَيْثُ أَصَابَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: فسخرنا له الريح تجري بامره رخاء حيث اصاب
ayahs.translation_saheeh: So We subjected to him the wind blowing by his command, gently, wherever he directed
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: So We gave him power over the wind, which at his request ran gently wherever he willed

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ كُلَّ بَنَّآءࣲ وَغَوَّاصࣲ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَالشَّيَاطِينَ كُلَّ بَنَّاءٍ وَغَوَّاصٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: والشياطين كل بناء وغواص
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And [also] the devils [of jinn] - every builder and diver
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and the jinn––every kind of builder and diver

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَءَاخَرِينَ مُقَرَّنِينَ فِي ٱلۡأَصۡفَادِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَآخَرِينَ مُقَرَّنِينَ فِي الْأَصْفَادِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: واخرين مقرنين في الاصفاد
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And others bound together in shackles
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and others chained in fetters

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: هَٰذَا عَطَآؤُنَا فَٱمۡنُنۡ أَوۡ أَمۡسِكۡ بِغَيۡرِ حِسَابࣲ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: هَٰذَا عَطَاؤُنَا فَامْنُنْ أَوْ أَمْسِكْ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: هذا عطاؤنا فامنن او امسك بغير حساب
ayahs.translation_saheeh: [We said], "This is Our gift, so grant or withhold without account
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: ‘This is Our gift, so give or withhold as you wish without account.’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَإِنَّ لَهُۥ عِندَنَا لَزُلۡفَىٰ وَحُسۡنَ مَـَٔابࣲ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَإِنَّ لَهُ عِنْدَنَا لَزُلْفَىٰ وَحُسْنَ مَآبٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: وان له عندنا لزلفى وحسن ماب
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And indeed, for him is nearness to Us and a good place of return
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: His reward will be nearness to Us, and a good place to return to

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَٱذۡكُرۡ عَبۡدَنَآ أَيُّوبَ إِذۡ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّي مَسَّنِيَ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ بِنُصۡبࣲ وَعَذَابٍ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَاذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَا أَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُ أَنِّي مَسَّنِيَ الشَّيْطَانُ بِنُصْبٍ وَعَذَابٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: واذكر عبدنا ايوب اذ نادى ربه اني مسني الشيطان بنصب وعذاب
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And remember Our servant Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, Satan has touched me with hardship and torment
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Bring to mind Our servant Job who cried to his Lord, ‘Satan has afflicted me with weariness and suffering.’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: ٱرۡكُضۡ بِرِجۡلِكَۖ هَٰذَا مُغۡتَسَلُۢ بَارِدࣱ وَشَرَابࣱ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: ارْكُضْ بِرِجْلِكَ ۖ هَٰذَا مُغْتَسَلٌ بَارِدٌ وَشَرَابٌ
ayahs.arabic_clean: اركض برجلك ۖ هذا مغتسل بارد وشراب
ayahs.translation_saheeh: [So he was told], "Strike [the ground] with your foot; this is a [spring for] a cool bath and drink
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: ‘Stamp your foot! Here is cool water for you to wash in and drink,’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَوَهَبۡنَا لَهُۥٓ أَهۡلَهُۥ وَمِثۡلَهُم مَّعَهُمۡ رَحۡمَةࣰ مِّنَّا وَذِكۡرَىٰ لِأُوْلِي ٱلۡأَلۡبَٰبِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُ أَهْلَهُ وَمِثْلَهُمْ مَعَهُمْ رَحْمَةً مِنَّا وَذِكْرَىٰ لِأُولِي الْأَلْبَابِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ووهبنا له اهله ومثلهم معهم رحمة منا وذكرى لاولي الالباب
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And We granted him his family and a like [number] with them as mercy from Us and a reminder for those of understanding
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and We restored his family to him, with many more like them: a sign of Our mercy and a lesson to all who understand

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَخُذۡ بِيَدِكَ ضِغۡثࣰ ا فَٱضۡرِب بِّهِۦ وَلَا تَحۡنَثۡۗ إِنَّا وَجَدۡنَٰهُ صَابِرࣰ اۚ نِّعۡمَ ٱلۡعَبۡدُ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابࣱ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَخُذْ بِيَدِكَ ضِغْثًا فَاضْرِبْ بِهِ وَلَا تَحْنَثْ ۗ إِنَّا وَجَدْنَاهُ صَابِرًا ۚ نِعْمَ الْعَبْدُ ۖ إِنَّهُ أَوَّابٌ
ayahs.arabic_clean: وخذ بيدك ضغثا فاضرب به ولا تحنث ۗ انا وجدناه صابرا ۚ نعم العبد ۖ انه اواب
ayahs.translation_saheeh: [We said], "And take in your hand a bunch [of grass] and strike with it and do not break your oath." Indeed, We found him patient, an excellent servant. Indeed, he was one repeatedly turning back [to Allah]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: ‘Take a small bunch of grass in your hand, and strike [her] with that so as not to break your oath.’ We found him patient in adversity; an excellent servant! He, too, always turned to God

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَٱذۡكُرۡ عِبَٰدَنَآ إِبۡرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسۡحَٰقَ وَيَعۡقُوبَ أُوْلِي ٱلۡأَيۡدِي وَٱلۡأَبۡصَٰرِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَاذْكُرْ عِبَادَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَإِسْحَاقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ أُولِي الْأَيْدِي وَالْأَبْصَارِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: واذكر عبادنا ابراهيم واسحاق ويعقوب اولي الايدي والابصار
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And remember Our servants, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob - those of strength and [religious] vision
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Remember Our servants Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, all men of strength and vision

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَخۡلَصۡنَٰهُم بِخَالِصَةࣲ ذِكۡرَى ٱلدَّارِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِنَّا أَخْلَصْنَاهُمْ بِخَالِصَةٍ ذِكْرَى الدَّارِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: انا اخلصناهم بخالصة ذكرى الدار
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, We chose them for an exclusive quality: remembrance of the home [of the Hereafter]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We caused them to be devoted to Us through their sincere remembrance of the Final Home

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُمۡ عِندَنَا لَمِنَ ٱلۡمُصۡطَفَيۡنَ ٱلۡأَخۡيَارِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَإِنَّهُمْ عِنْدَنَا لَمِنَ الْمُصْطَفَيْنَ الْأَخْيَارِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: وانهم عندنا لمن المصطفين الاخيار
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And indeed they are, to Us, among the chosen and outstanding
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: with Us they will be among the elect, the truly good

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَٱذۡكُرۡ إِسۡمَٰعِيلَ وَٱلۡيَسَعَ وَذَا ٱلۡكِفۡلِۖ وَكُلࣱّ مِّنَ ٱلۡأَخۡيَارِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَاذْكُرْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ وَالْيَسَعَ وَذَا الْكِفْلِ ۖ وَكُلٌّ مِنَ الْأَخْيَارِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: واذكر اسماعيل واليسع وذا الكفل ۖ وكل من الاخيار
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And remember Ishmael, Elisha and Dhul-Kifl, and all are among the outstanding
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: And remember Our servants Ishmael, Elisha, and Dhu ’l-Kifl, each of them truly good

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: هَٰذَا ذِكۡرࣱۚ وَإِنَّ لِلۡمُتَّقِينَ لَحُسۡنَ مَـَٔابࣲ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: هَٰذَا ذِكْرٌ ۚ وَإِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ لَحُسْنَ مَآبٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: هذا ذكر ۚ وان للمتقين لحسن ماب
ayahs.translation_saheeh: This is a reminder. And indeed, for the righteous is a good place of return
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: This is a lesson. The devout will have a good place to return to

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: جَنَّٰتِ عَدۡنࣲ مُّفَتَّحَةࣰ لَّهُمُ ٱلۡأَبۡوَٰبُ
ayahs.arabic_simple: جَنَّاتِ عَدْنٍ مُفَتَّحَةً لَهُمُ الْأَبْوَابُ
ayahs.arabic_clean: جنات عدن مفتحة لهم الابواب
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Gardens of perpetual residence, whose doors will be opened to them
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Gardens of lasting bliss with gates wide open

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا يَدۡعُونَ فِيهَا بِفَٰكِهَةࣲ كَثِيرَةࣲ وَشَرَابࣲ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: مُتَّكِئِينَ فِيهَا يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِفَاكِهَةٍ كَثِيرَةٍ وَشَرَابٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: متكئين فيها يدعون فيها بفاكهة كثيرة وشراب
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Reclining within them, they will call therein for abundant fruit and drink
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: They will be comfortably seated; they will call for abundant fruit and drink

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: ۞وَعِندَهُمۡ قَٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرۡفِ أَتۡرَابٌ
ayahs.arabic_simple: ۞ وَعِنْدَهُمْ قَاصِرَاتُ الطَّرْفِ أَتْرَابٌ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ۞ وعندهم قاصرات الطرف اتراب
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And with them will be women limiting [their] glances and of equal age
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: they will have well-matched [wives] with modest gaze

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: هَٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِيَوۡمِ ٱلۡحِسَابِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: هَٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِيَوْمِ الْحِسَابِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: هذا ما توعدون ليوم الحساب
ayahs.translation_saheeh: This is what you, [the righteous], are promised for the Day of Account
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: ‘This is what you are promised for the Day of Reckoning

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَرِزۡقُنَا مَا لَهُۥ مِن نَّفَادٍ
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَرِزْقُنَا مَا لَهُ مِنْ نَفَادٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ان هذا لرزقنا ما له من نفاد
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, this is Our provision; for it there is no depletion
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Our provision for you will never end.’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: هَٰذَاۚ وَإِنَّ لِلطَّٰغِينَ لَشَرَّ مَـَٔابࣲ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: هَٰذَا ۚ وَإِنَّ لِلطَّاغِينَ لَشَرَّ مَآبٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: هذا ۚ وان للطاغين لشر ماب
ayahs.translation_saheeh: This [is so]. But indeed, for the transgressors is an evil place of return
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: But the evildoers will have the worst place to return to

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: جَهَنَّمَ يَصۡلَوۡنَهَا فَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡمِهَادُ
ayahs.arabic_simple: جَهَنَّمَ يَصْلَوْنَهَا فَبِئْسَ الْمِهَادُ
ayahs.arabic_clean: جهنم يصلونها فبئس المهاد
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Hell, which they will [enter to] burn, and wretched is the resting place
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Hell to burn in, an evil place to stay

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: هَٰذَا فَلۡيَذُوقُوهُ حَمِيمࣱ وَغَسَّاقࣱ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: هَٰذَا فَلْيَذُوقُوهُ حَمِيمٌ وَغَسَّاقٌ
ayahs.arabic_clean: هذا فليذوقوه حميم وغساق
ayahs.translation_saheeh: This - so let them taste it - is scalding water and [foul] purulence
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: all this will be theirs: let them taste it- a scalding, dark, foul fluid

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَءَاخَرُ مِن شَكۡلِهِۦٓ أَزۡوَٰجٌ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَآخَرُ مِنْ شَكْلِهِ أَزْوَاجٌ
ayahs.arabic_clean: واخر من شكله ازواج
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And other [punishments] of its type [in various] kinds
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and other such torments

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: هَٰذَا فَوۡجࣱ مُّقۡتَحِمࣱ مَّعَكُمۡ لَا مَرۡحَبَۢا بِهِمۡۚ إِنَّهُمۡ صَالُواْ ٱلنَّارِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: هَٰذَا فَوْجٌ مُقْتَحِمٌ مَعَكُمْ ۖ لَا مَرْحَبًا بِهِمْ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ صَالُو النَّارِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: هذا فوج مقتحم معكم ۖ لا مرحبا بهم ۚ انهم صالو النار
ayahs.translation_saheeh: [Its inhabitants will say], "This is a company bursting in with you. No welcome for them. Indeed, they will burn in the Fire
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: [It will be said], ‘Here is another crowd of people rushing headlong to join you.’ [The response will be], ‘They are not welcome! They will burn in the Fire.’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: قَالُواْ بَلۡ أَنتُمۡ لَا مَرۡحَبَۢا بِكُمۡۖ أَنتُمۡ قَدَّمۡتُمُوهُ لَنَاۖ فَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡقَرَارُ
ayahs.arabic_simple: قَالُوا بَلْ أَنْتُمْ لَا مَرْحَبًا بِكُمْ ۖ أَنْتُمْ قَدَّمْتُمُوهُ لَنَا ۖ فَبِئْسَ الْقَرَارُ
ayahs.arabic_clean: قالوا بل انتم لا مرحبا بكم ۖ انتم قدمتموه لنا ۖ فبئس القرار
ayahs.translation_saheeh: They will say, "Nor you! No welcome for you. You, [our leaders], brought this upon us, and wretched is the settlement
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: They will say to them, ‘You are not welcome! It was you who brought this on us, an evil place to stay,’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: قَالُواْ رَبَّنَا مَن قَدَّمَ لَنَا هَٰذَا فَزِدۡهُ عَذَابࣰ ا ضِعۡفࣰ ا فِي ٱلنَّارِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: قَالُوا رَبَّنَا مَنْ قَدَّمَ لَنَا هَٰذَا فَزِدْهُ عَذَابًا ضِعْفًا فِي النَّارِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: قالوا ربنا من قدم لنا هذا فزده عذابا ضعفا في النار
ayahs.translation_saheeh: They will say, "Our Lord, whoever brought this upon us - increase for him double punishment in the Fire
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: adding, ‘Our Lord, give double punishment to those who brought this upon us.’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَقَالُواْ مَا لَنَا لَا نَرَىٰ رِجَالࣰ ا كُنَّا نَعُدُّهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأَشۡرَارِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَقَالُوا مَا لَنَا لَا نَرَىٰ رِجَالًا كُنَّا نَعُدُّهُمْ مِنَ الْأَشْرَارِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: وقالوا ما لنا لا نرى رجالا كنا نعدهم من الاشرار
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And they will say, "Why do we not see men whom we used to count among the worst
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: They will say, ‘Why do we not see those we thought were bad

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: أَتَّخَذۡنَٰهُمۡ سِخۡرِيًّا أَمۡ زَاغَتۡ عَنۡهُمُ ٱلۡأَبۡصَٰرُ
ayahs.arabic_simple: أَتَّخَذْنَاهُمْ سِخْرِيًّا أَمْ زَاغَتْ عَنْهُمُ الْأَبْصَارُ
ayahs.arabic_clean: اتخذناهم سخريا ام زاغت عنهم الابصار
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Is it [because] we took them in ridicule, or has [our] vision turned away from them
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and took as a laughing-stock? Have our eyes missed them?’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ لَحَقࣱّ تَخَاصُمُ أَهۡلِ ٱلنَّارِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ لَحَقٌّ تَخَاصُمُ أَهْلِ النَّارِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ان ذلك لحق تخاصم اهل النار
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, that is truth - the quarreling of the people of the Fire
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: This is how it will really be: the inhabitants of the Fire will blame one another in this way

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: قُلۡ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ مُنذِرࣱۖ وَمَا مِنۡ إِلَٰهٍ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡوَٰحِدُ ٱلۡقَهَّارُ
ayahs.arabic_simple: قُلْ إِنَّمَا أَنَا مُنْذِرٌ ۖ وَمَا مِنْ إِلَٰهٍ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْوَاحِدُ الْقَهَّارُ
ayahs.arabic_clean: قل انما انا منذر ۖ وما من اله الا الله الواحد القهار
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Say, [O Muhammad], "I am only a warner, and there is not any deity except Allah, the One, the Prevailing
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: [Prophet] say, ‘I am only here to give warning. There is no god but God the One, the All Powerful

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡغَفَّٰرُ
ayahs.arabic_simple: رَبُّ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا الْعَزِيزُ الْغَفَّارُ
ayahs.arabic_clean: رب السماوات والارض وما بينهما العزيز الغفار
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Exalted in Might, the Perpetual Forgiver
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Lord of the heavens and earth and everything between, the Almighty, the Most Forgiving.’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: قُلۡ هُوَ نَبَؤٌاْ عَظِيمٌ
ayahs.arabic_simple: قُلْ هُوَ نَبَأٌ عَظِيمٌ
ayahs.arabic_clean: قل هو نبا عظيم
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Say, "It is great news
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Say, ‘This message is a mighty one

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: أَنتُمۡ عَنۡهُ مُعۡرِضُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: أَنْتُمْ عَنْهُ مُعْرِضُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: انتم عنه معرضون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: From which you turn away
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: yet you ignore it

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: مَا كَانَ لِيَ مِنۡ عِلۡمِۭ بِٱلۡمَلَإِ ٱلۡأَعۡلَىٰٓ إِذۡ يَخۡتَصِمُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: مَا كَانَ لِيَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ بِالْمَلَإِ الْأَعْلَىٰ إِذْ يَخْتَصِمُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ما كان لي من علم بالملا الاعلى اذ يختصمون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: I had no knowledge of the exalted assembly [of angels] when they were disputing [the creation of Adam]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: I have no knowledge of what those on high discuss

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِن يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَيَّ إِلَّآ أَنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرࣱ مُّبِينٌ
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِنْ يُوحَىٰ إِلَيَّ إِلَّا أَنَّمَا أَنَا نَذِيرٌ مُبِينٌ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ان يوحى الي الا انما انا نذير مبين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: It has not been revealed to me except that I am a clear warner
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: it is only revealed to me that I am here to give clear warning.’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِذۡ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّي خَٰلِقُۢ بَشَرࣰ ا مِّن طِينࣲ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَائِكَةِ إِنِّي خَالِقٌ بَشَرًا مِنْ طِينٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: اذ قال ربك للملائكة اني خالق بشرا من طين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: [So mention] when your Lord said to the angels, "Indeed, I am going to create a human being from clay
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Your Lord said to the angels, ‘I will create a man from clay

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَإِذَا سَوَّيۡتُهُۥ وَنَفَخۡتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِي فَقَعُواْ لَهُۥ سَٰجِدِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَإِذَا سَوَّيْتُهُ وَنَفَخْتُ فِيهِ مِنْ رُوحِي فَقَعُوا لَهُ سَاجِدِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: فاذا سويته ونفخت فيه من روحي فقعوا له ساجدين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: So when I have proportioned him and breathed into him of My [created] soul, then fall down to him in prostration
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: When I have shaped him and breathed from My Spirit into him, bow down before him.’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَسَجَدَ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ كُلُّهُمۡ أَجۡمَعُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَسَجَدَ الْمَلَائِكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ أَجْمَعُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: فسجد الملائكة كلهم اجمعون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: So the angels prostrated - all of them entirely
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: The angels all bowed down together

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِلَّآ إِبۡلِيسَ ٱسۡتَكۡبَرَ وَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِلَّا إِبْلِيسَ اسْتَكْبَرَ وَكَانَ مِنَ الْكَافِرِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: الا ابليس استكبر وكان من الكافرين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Except Iblees; he was arrogant and became among the disbelievers
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: but not Iblis, who was too proud. He became a rebel

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: قَالَ يَٰٓإِبۡلِيسُ مَا مَنَعَكَ أَن تَسۡجُدَ لِمَا خَلَقۡتُ بِيَدَيَّۖ أَسۡتَكۡبَرۡتَ أَمۡ كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلۡعَالِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: قَالَ يَا إِبْلِيسُ مَا مَنَعَكَ أَنْ تَسْجُدَ لِمَا خَلَقْتُ بِيَدَيَّ ۖ أَسْتَكْبَرْتَ أَمْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الْعَالِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: قال يا ابليس ما منعك ان تسجد لما خلقت بيدي ۖ استكبرت ام كنت من العالين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: [Allah] said, "O Iblees, what prevented you from prostrating to that which I created with My hands? Were you arrogant [then], or were you [already] among the haughty
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: God said, ‘Iblis, what prevents you from bowing down to the man I have made with My own hands? Are you too high and mighty?’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: قَالَ أَنَا۠ خَيۡرࣱ مِّنۡهُ خَلَقۡتَنِي مِن نَّارࣲ وَخَلَقۡتَهُۥ مِن طِينࣲ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: قَالَ أَنَا خَيْرٌ مِنْهُ ۖ خَلَقْتَنِي مِنْ نَارٍ وَخَلَقْتَهُ مِنْ طِينٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: قال انا خير منه ۖ خلقتني من نار وخلقته من طين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: He said, "I am better than him. You created me from fire and created him from clay
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Iblis said, ‘I am better than him: You made me from fire, and him from clay.’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: قَالَ فَٱخۡرُجۡ مِنۡهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمࣱ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: قَالَ فَاخْرُجْ مِنْهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٌ
ayahs.arabic_clean: قال فاخرج منها فانك رجيم
ayahs.translation_saheeh: [Allah] said, "Then get out of Paradise, for indeed, you are expelled
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: ‘Get out of here! You are rejected

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَإِنَّ عَلَيۡكَ لَعۡنَتِيٓ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ ٱلدِّينِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكَ لَعْنَتِي إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ الدِّينِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: وان عليك لعنتي الى يوم الدين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And indeed, upon you is My curse until the Day of Recompense
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: My rejection will follow you till the Day of Judgement!’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرۡنِيٓ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ يُبۡعَثُونَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنْظِرْنِي إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: قال رب فانظرني الى يوم يبعثون
ayahs.translation_saheeh: He said, "My Lord, then reprieve me until the Day they are resurrected
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: but Iblis said, ‘My Lord, grant me respite until the Day when they are raised from the dead,’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُنظَرِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ الْمُنْظَرِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: قال فانك من المنظرين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: [Allah] said, "So indeed, you are of those reprieved
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: so He said, ‘You have respite

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ ٱلۡوَقۡتِ ٱلۡمَعۡلُومِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ الْوَقْتِ الْمَعْلُومِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: الى يوم الوقت المعلوم
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Until the Day of the time well-known
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: till the Appointed Day.’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: قَالَ فَبِعِزَّتِكَ لَأُغۡوِيَنَّهُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: قَالَ فَبِعِزَّتِكَ لَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: قال فبعزتك لاغوينهم اجمعين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: [Iblees] said, "By your might, I will surely mislead them all
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Iblis said, ‘I swear by Your might! I will tempt all

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنۡهُمُ ٱلۡمُخۡلَصِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ الْمُخْلَصِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: الا عبادك منهم المخلصين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Except, among them, Your chosen servants
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: but Your true servants.’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: قَالَ فَٱلۡحَقُّ وَٱلۡحَقَّ أَقُولُ
ayahs.arabic_simple: قَالَ فَالْحَقُّ وَالْحَقَّ أَقُولُ
ayahs.arabic_clean: قال فالحق والحق اقول
ayahs.translation_saheeh: [Allah] said, "The truth [is My oath], and the truth I say
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: God said, ‘This is the truth- I speak only the truth

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: لَأَمۡلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنكَ وَمِمَّن تَبِعَكَ مِنۡهُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: لَأَمْلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنْكَ وَمِمَّنْ تَبِعَكَ مِنْهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: لاملان جهنم منك وممن تبعك منهم اجمعين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: [That] I will surely fill Hell with you and those of them that follow you all together
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: I will fill Hell with you and all those that follow you.’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: قُلۡ مَآ أَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ أَجۡرࣲ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلۡمُتَكَلِّفِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: قُلْ مَا أَسْأَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ وَمَا أَنَا مِنَ الْمُتَكَلِّفِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: قل ما اسالكم عليه من اجر وما انا من المتكلفين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Say, [O Muhammad], "I do not ask you for the Qur'an any payment, and I am not of the pretentious
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: [Prophet], say, ‘I ask no reward from you for this, nor do I claim to be what I am not

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِنۡ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكۡرࣱ لِّلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِلْعَالَمِينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ان هو الا ذكر للعالمين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: It is but a reminder to the worlds
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: this is only a warning for all people

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَلَتَعۡلَمُنَّ نَبَأَهُۥ بَعۡدَ حِينِۭ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَلَتَعْلَمُنَّ نَبَأَهُ بَعْدَ حِينٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ولتعلمن نباه بعد حين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And you will surely know [the truth of] its information after a time
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: In time you will certainly come to know its truth.’
